context: Two coworkers brainstorm appeal points for new packaging
purpose: Teach: サンプル/チラシ/最低限/呼びかけ/アピール/パッケージ/ポスター/数多く

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新しい商品のパッケージデザイン、もう見ました？
lines.en: Did you already see the new product packaging design?
lines.style: Casual but polite tone between female coworker brainstorming

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うん、サンプル品が届いてたから一通り目を通したよ。
lines.en: Yeah, the sample products arrived so I looked through them all.
lines.style: Relaxed male coworker reply, mid-twenties professional voice

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: じゃあアピールポイントを整理して、チラシに載せたいんですけど。
lines.en: Then I'd like to organize the appeal points and put them on flyers.
lines.style: Forward-thinking female colleague, business casual register

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いいね。最低限、素材のこだわりと価格の手頃さは押さえておきたいな。
lines.en: Good idea. At minimum we should cover material quality and affordability.
lines.style: Thoughtful male voice listing priorities, calm pacing

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 店頭のポスターでも同じメッセージで呼びかけるべきですよね。
lines.en: We should call out the same message on the in-store posters too, right?
lines.style: Confirming female tone, slightly rising at sentence end

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうだね。SNSでもチラシと連動させれば、数多くのお客さんに届くはず。
lines.en: Right. If we link social media with the flyers, it should reach many customers.
lines.style: Mid-energy male voice, confident strategic suggestion

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: じゃあ私、明日までにアピール文の案を三つ作ってきます。
lines.en: Then I'll prepare three draft appeal messages by tomorrow.
lines.style: Cheerful committed female voice, slightly upbeat closing

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 助かるよ。俺はパッケージの写真選びを担当するね。
lines.en: That'd be a big help. I'll handle picking the packaging photos.
lines.style: Friendly male coworker, warm appreciative delivery
